supporting_observations.claim: WS-BCARTER-01 made repeated HTTPS CONNECT attempts to update.chartmate-imaging.net at roughly five-minute intervals from 13:38 through 14:08 UTC. Some were successful proxy tunnels; others returned 407 or 502.

The connections are associated with cmupdate.exe running as ben.carter from the user-writable path C:\Users\ben.carter\AppData\Local\ChartMate\cmupdate.exe; Sysmon records the process and its network connections to the proxy.
A file-creation event from that process targets the same cmupdate.exe path; this record alone does not establish what changed or whether the executable was modified.

The observed hostname ends in .net, whereas the inventory identifies the approved ChartMate updater check as update.chartmate-imaging.com. Together with the user-profile executable path, this discrepancy warrants investigation, but does not establish maliciousness.

known_telemetry_limitations: The proxy records show CONNECT metadata, status, byte counts, and duration, but do not show the HTTPS payload, certificate details, or requested update content (for example, T015-00110 and T015-00209).
The supplied records do not include a hash or signature verification for the cmupdate.exe at the observed user-profile path (T015-00108, T015-00114).
The supplied collection status reports an outage for WS-LPARK-01 during 13:30–14:10 UTC, but reports collection as OK for other hosts; this outage is not on the alerted host.
claims_not_established: Whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is a legitimate ChartMate domain, authorized alias, or unrelated destination.
Whether the observed executable is vendor-signed, authentic, or the same binary as the inventoried ChartMate updater.
Whether the HTTPS sessions downloaded, uploaded, or executed any content, or whether any compromise resulted.
Why some proxy attempts returned 407 or 502 and whether those failures were ordinary transient errors.
additional_evidence_needed: Acquire and verify the executable's hash, digital signature, version, and file contents; compare them with the approved ChartMate installation and vendor-published artifacts.
Confirm with ChartMate or the software owner whether update.chartmate-imaging.net is an authorized endpoint or alias for update.chartmate-imaging.com.
Retrieve DNS resolution, TLS certificate/SNI details, and any available proxy or endpoint records exposing the actual HTTPS request and response content.
Check the updater's installation and change history on WS-BCARTER-01 and compare its location, hash, and network behavior on other workstations.
unrelated_findings: At 13:54:48 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 made an SMB connection to FILE-HD-01 that was followed by an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon. This is outside the alerted HTTPS activity and should be reviewed separately; the records do not establish its purpose or impact. (T015-00253, T015-00255, T015-00257)
